title: Prompt Iteration Cycle
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Prompt Engineering
description: A five-step refinement loop - write, send, evaluate, diagnose, refine - with a quality gauge in the centre that climbs as the learner works around the cycle.

learningObjectives: Explain the iterative process of prompt refinement
Describe how each step contributes to improving response quality

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Cyclical diagram with click-through worked examples and a cumulative quality gauge
keyQuestions: Which of the five steps do people usually skip?
Is there a point where more iteration stops paying off?
commonMisconceptions: Treating a poor first response as a verdict rather than data
Refining a prompt without first diagnosing what went wrong
assessmentOpportunities: Name all five steps in order
State a diagnosis in the form 'the response was X because the prompt lacked Y'
